title: Shielded soffit vent assembly
priority_reference: US provisional application 63/771,420 (as recited in disclosure)

source_provenance.note: Provided text includes abstract, specification and seven claims; SHA-256 applies to the uploaded text, not an independently retrieved USPTO PDF.

publicly_described_functional_concepts: screened soffit opening admits normal attic airflow while limiting debris and pests
human-moved protective barrier intended to obstruct the vent during firestorm or high-wind conditions
barrier can be removable or retained with the vent body
disclosure proposes a mineral-filled polymer composite for the vent body and screen
intended protection against windborne ember intrusion and high-wind pressure effects

core_architecture: manually positioned barrier for hazardous conditions
scope_model.patent_described_operation: routine mode allows attic airflow; before anticipated fire or extreme wind, a person manually positions a protective barrier to obstruct the opening. No autonomous actuator or networked system is disclosed.
building_patterns_relevant_to_independen: model routine ventilation and protective closure as distinct independently tested states
define installation, maintenance, inspection and safe recovery procedures
keep evidence for airflow, ember resistance and durability rather than infer performance
consider the building envelope as a system rather than treating one component as fireproof
separate public weather context and human decisions from any unclaimed automation
research_and_simulation_metrics_not_pate: ember intrusion under validated test conditions
condensation and moisture risk under closure

claim_scope_signals.independent_claim_theme: screened soffit ventilation device with integrated mounting and a manually moveable barrier for blocking airflow
claim_scope_signals.legal_scope_rule: A1 publication does not establish grant, enforceability, freedom to operate, or right to manufacture; live legal status and prosecution require qualified review.

family_signals.territorial_status_rule: No inference of worldwide rights or freedom to operate from a US application publication.

building_memory.derived_design_note: This read-only software dashboard is a separate, independently proposed research abstraction. The cited patent describes manual closure, not autonomous sensing, remote control, or a networked system.

design_divergence_defaults: define independent safety case and requirements rather than copying the disclosed design
evaluate alternate ventilation measures under qualified building-science review
do not convert manual disclosure into implied automatic emergency control
separate decision support from physical control
require certified tests, code review, engineering review and rights review before real-world use

mandatory_safety_boundaries: no copying patent figures or claim language
